display_long_description:
Welcome to ANIMAL RIVALS, the most intense monkey shooter on Meta Quest. Inspired by classic shooters and the gorilla movement system, you can challenge friends (or enemies!) to 1v1, 2v2, or 3v3 duels,  get chaotic with Team Deathmatch, or defeat a zombie horde in the Infected mode!

[media]

🥖 Fresh updates every week. 

[media]

🔫 Challenge opponents to duels

[media]

💵 Earn Foundation Coins to unlock new weapons & gear 

📜 Complete contracts to build WILD Loadouts

🏆 Become the G.O.A.T.

Join thousands of rivals in the Discord for updates, challenges, giveaways and sneak peaks! 

Discord.gg/animalrivalsvr

Play now!
